title: Compliance Opportunity Triage and Account-Aware Prioritization Lab
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise account teams and security reviewers receive a heterogeneous stream of compliance and security asks (SOC2 evidence requests, vendor questionnaires, data residency DPAs, HIPAA scoping). The current intake is manual, slow to prioritize, and often routed without account context, leading to long SLAs and duplicated work.

Goal: Design and validate a lightweight, account-aware triage flow that scores security/compliance requests by risk and opportunity, synthesizes a minimal evidence set, and routes to the right lane (self-serve, compliance team, legal, or engineering) with SLA targets. The lab will produce a prioritized rule set and a decision scaffold we can turn into Console intake UI and an automation runbook.

Outcomes: 1) Reduce median response time for high-risk security asks to <= 5 business days. 2) Surface a ranked lane and required evidence bundle for >= 80% of new requests automatically. 3) Provide a decision matrix that integrates account contract tier, data residency, and product surface impacted (hosted/dedicated/private).

Scope: Focus on non-bug compliance asks from customers and prospects (questionnaires, SOC2/ISO evidence, DPAs, HIPAA checklists). Exclude core engineering remediation and audits for this phase.

Constraints: Must integrate with existing intake forms (Zendesk/Forms), create an affordance for manual override, and limit initial automation to triage and evidence-synthesis recommendations (no automated legal sign-off).
acceptance_criteria: Documented triage rubric mapping request attributes to risk tiers and routing lanes
Prototype intake UI mock in Figma with account-aware fields and override affordances
Automation playbook that generates a recommended evidence bundle and a priority score
Stakeholder sign-off from Security, Legal, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success on triage rules
Pilot routing implemented in Zendesk with metrics instrumented (time-to-first-ack, time-to-resolution)
tasks: Interview 6 enterprise account managers and 4 security reviewers to capture pain points and handoffs
Create triage rubric draft and run 50 historical requests through it for validation
Design Figma prototype for account-aware intake and notification flows
Build a lightweight lambda that ingests form payloads and returns a JSON triage result (score + recommended evidence bundle)
Instrument pilot metrics in Datadog dashboard and create pre-built dashboard link
Conduct a 2-week pilot with 3 enterprise accounts and gather feedback
Update runbook and handoff to Console PM for productization backlog entry

Opportunity: If triage reduces engineering handoffs, we can reallocate 1-2 FTEs from the security queue to proactive enablement.
